description: Find Dreame L10s Ultra replacement filters, a main brush, dust bags and mop pads. Compare verified pack contents and distinguish the original model from Gen 2 and Pro variants.
scope: This guide covers the original U.S. Dreame L10s Ultra robot and its auto-empty, mop-wash base. It does not cover the L10s Ultra Gen 2, L10s Pro Ultra Heat or L10s Pro Ultra; their parts and dock accessories can differ.
warning: Check the exact model name in the Dreamehome app or on the robot. The L10s Ultra Gen 2 and L10s Pro Ultra Heat have separate official accessory listings; a broad seller claim or shared Dreame name does not prove every component fits.

compatibility.part: Original L10s Ultra vs. Gen 2 / Pro Ultra Heat
compatibility.detail: Dreame lists the original L10s Ultra, L10s Ultra Gen 2 and L10s Pro Ultra Heat as separate models. The linked 24-piece kit explicitly excludes Gen 2 and Pro Ultra Heat. Check each component listing and your exact model before ordering.

Dreame's 3 L L10s Ultra/L20 Ultra bags are a different product from the 3.2 L bags listed for later models including L10s Ultra Gen 2. Match the bag collar and dock track; do not rely on capacity or a broad 'Dreame Ultra' claim alone.

compatibility.part: Robot-bin filter vs. dock dust bag
compatibility.detail: The reusable filter sits in the robot's dust bin. The disposable bag fits inside the base station. They are separate parts, with separate fit checks and replacement intervals.
The L10s Ultra has two rotating round mop pads attached to holders. The linked six-pack contains cloth pads only; it is not a pair of mop holders or a motorized mop assembly.

careTip: Rinse the filter with clean water only and let it dry completely before reinstalling it. Remove hair from both ends of the main brush before replacing it. The base washes mop pads automatically; inspect them and clean as needed. The app can notify you when the dock bag is due; actual replacement timing depends on use.

questions.question: Do L10s Ultra Gen 2 replacement parts fit the original L10s Ultra?
questions.answer: Do not assume they do. Dreame lists these as separate models, and some accessories differ: for example, the original L10s Ultra uses a 3 L dust bag, while Dreame lists 3.2 L bags for later models such as Gen 2. Check every component against the full model name.

questions.question: Which dust bag fits the original Dreame L10s Ultra?
questions.answer: Dreame lists an original L10s Ultra/L20 Ultra bag with 3 L capacity. The third-party 10-pack linked here names the original L10s Ultra and also states 3 L. Compare the bag collar and slide-in track with your original before ordering.

questions.question: How often should I replace the L10s Ultra filter and brushes?
questions.answer: Dreame's routine-maintenance table gives 3–6 months for the dust-bin filter, 6–12 months for the main brush and 3–6 months for the side brush. Cleaning frequency and wear can change the timing; use the app's reminders and inspect parts regularly.

questions.question: Are these genuine Dreame parts?
questions.answer: No. The linked filters, roller, bags, mop pads and 24-piece kit are third-party listings. Dreame's catalog and manual support the model and part type, while fit statements and pack contents for those Amazon products come from their sellers.
